Thinking is on with no thinking field. disabled at xhigh or max returns 400. /v1/models now declares thinking.types.disabled but not the effort limit. With thinking off, the model can skip a tool call it needs when JSON output is also requested.

Thinking is on with no thinking field. disabled at xhigh or max returns 400, checked on each request. With thinking disabled the model can occasionally emit tool calls as plain text or internal XML tags in its visible output.

Announced 2026-09-30. Requests fail after the retirement date. The page names only the dated id; the alias claude-sonnet-4-5 points to it. Partner platforms (Bedrock, Google Cloud) set their own dates.

Effort levels keep their names but are recalibrated against Claude Sonnet 5: a level does not produce the same amount of thinking. Anthropic's starting points: medium for well-specified agentic work (high for harder or longer tasks), medium or low for chat and latency-sensitive work.

thinking.type "disabled" returns a 400 on this model; to run without up-front thinking send {"type": "between_tools"} (progress updates between tool calls still come back as thinking blocks). between_tools is refused (400) at effort xhigh and max, accepts no display, budget_tokens or block_binding, and fixes the effort for the whole conversation (a per-message output_config.effort that differs returns 400). With no thinking field the model thinks (adaptive). GET /v1/models lists only adaptive and enabled=false under capabilities.thinking.types: it declares neither between_tools nor the refusal of disabled.

disabled returns 400. between_tools turns off up-front thinking only: progress updates between tool calls still come back as thinking blocks; without tools the response is text only. Thinking is on with no thinking field.
Thinking cannot be turned off: disabled and between_tools return 400. Lower the effort to think less.
disabled turns thinking off at any effort. With no thinking field, Claude Sonnet 5 thinks; the 4.x models do not.

PDF files are read by models with vision capabilities: the API sends the model both the extracted text and an image of each page. Chat Completions takes a PDF as a file content part; models without Chat Completions (Pro, Codex) take it through the Responses API as input_file. The model pages do not list PDF among input modalities, and their file_uploads feature is present on some models and absent on others without saying what it means for PDF.
